Bug_Title: DLS: Useless increment in return statement (DLS_DEAD_LOCAL_INCREMENT_IN_RETURN)
Bug_Details:
This statement has a return such as return x++; / return x--;.
A postfix increment/decrement does not impact the value of the expression,
so this increment/decrement has no effect.
Please verify that this statement does the right thing.
 return x++; return x--;
Bug_Explanation: The buggyMethodIncrement and buggyMethodDecrement methods contain a postfix increment and decrement operation in the return statement, which does not affect the value that is returned. This creates a situation where the increment or decrement operation is useless because it does not change the outcome of the return value.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case calls the showBug() method, which internally invokes buggyMethodIncrement and buggyMethodDecrement. These methods contain a postfix increment and decrement operation in the return statements, which do not affect the returned values, leading to a logical error and causing the test to fail.
